confidence_notes: Kampot-specific cost-of-living data provides current meal, cappuccino, and draft-beer anchors, but it is based on a small contributor pool. A Kampot delivery menu prices cocktails at $3-$4 and wine at $3.50 per glass; drink prices vary by venue. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external city prices were used. Food and drink anchors use Kampot-specific cost-of-living data and a local menu; accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of smaller Cambodian tourism towns.
